name: visualforge
description: Turn an app idea, Specforge output, or existing repo into a detail-obsessed, evidence-backed design system: tokens, components, motion, accessibility, surface treatments, micro-interactions, Figma artifacts, and frontend implementation contract.

interface.shortDescription: Detail-obsessed design system, tokens, components, motion, and Figma artifacts from intent or repo.
interface.longDescription: VisualForge generates a complete, opinionated design system from product intent or an existing repo. Every decision is specific, evidence-backed, and recorded with options, rationale, and reversal triggers. Outputs include markdown design docs, design tokens (JSON/CSS/TS), Figma file build via MCP (with JSON fallback), and agent rules that prevent drift across future contributors.
defaultPrompt: Use VisualForge to generate a complete design system for this app idea
Use VisualForge to upgrade the design from these Specforge docs
Use VisualForge to audit this repo and produce an ideal design plus drift report
Use VisualForge to build the design system in Figma using MCP
